env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
! logos build -o $WORK/direct$GOEXE ./direct
stderr 'undefined: rt.StringBytes'
! logos build -o $WORK/reverse$GOEXE ./reverse
stderr 'undefined: rt.BytesString'
logos build -o $WORK/view$GOEXE ./view
exec $WORK/view$GOEXE
stdout '^120 121$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/zerocopyexports

go 1.27

-- m/direct/main.lgo --
package main

import "logos/rt"

func main() {
	_ = rt.StringBytes("x")
}

-- m/reverse/main.lgo --
package main

import "logos/rt"

func main() {
	_ = rt.BytesString([]byte{'x'})
}

-- m/view/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	s := "xy"
	b := const []byte(s)
	fmt.Println(b[0], b[1])
}
